CRON.description: Set to '1' to enable daily maintenance via cron instead of systemd timer.

body_part_scan_size.description: Amount of data per email text/* mimepart, that will be run through body rules.

lock_method.description: Set file-locking method (flock is not safe over NFS, but is faster)

normalize_charset.description: Whether to decode non- UTF-8 and non-ASCII textual parts and recode them to UTF-8 before the text is given over to rules processing.

rawbody_part_scan_size.description: Amount of data per email text/* mimepart, that will be run through rawbody rules.

report_contact.description: A 'contact address' users should contact for more info. (replaces _CONTACTADDRESS_ in the report template)

report_safe.description: Save spam messages as a message/rfc822 MIME attachment instead of modifying the original message (0: off, 2: use text/plain instead)

required_score.description: Set the threshold at which a message is considered spam (default: 5.0)

rewrite_header_subject.description: Add *****SPAM***** to the Subject header of spam e-mails

trusted_networks.description: Set which networks or hosts are considered 'trusted' by your mail server (i.e. not spammers)
